title: Anomalous Atelier login from new geo · auto-contained
summary: Access Sentinel detected a successful login from Lagos, NG for a partner whose travel calendar showed Riyadh. Session revoked within 4 min; reset forced. Root cause: credential shared via WhatsApp screenshot during travel.

title: Backup verification failure · object storage replica
summary: Cross-region replica fell behind by 4h after a misconfigured retention policy. Restored within RPO; remediation: replication monitor added.

title: Customer-reported data export anomaly
summary: Engagement deliverable export included a row from a different engagement. Containment in progress; comms drafted, pending Partner sign-off.
